$comment: Security controls. Every checklist item needs at least one control; see docs/security/README.md.

controls.summary: Access tokens are verified by allowlisted asymmetric algorithms, issuer, audience, expiry and key.

checks.name: rejects an HMAC-signed token: symmetric algorithms are not allowlisted
rejects an unsecured token (alg: none)
rejects a wrong issuer
rejects a forged native kid signed by a different key
rejects an invalid token with 401 and no reason leaked
ignores a token in the query string even with no header or cookie

controls.summary: OIDC sign-in checks state and hands the token to the API; a refused handover fails sign-in.

checks.name: refuses a mismatched state without exchanging the code
reports a refused handover, so the operator sees that sign-in failed

controls.summary: Native and OIDC sign-in, renewal and logout succeed on the production profile; forged tokens fail there.

checks.blocker: needs the disposable production-profile TLS deployment

controls.summary: No script-readable storage holds a token, and a personal access token never authenticates from the cookie.

checks.name: writes nothing to any browser storage or script-readable cookie
removes the token an older build left in sessionStorage
refuses a personal access token from the cookie

controls.summary: Built web, CLI and bundle output carries no credential, source map or private file.
The shipped compose publishes only the gateway on every interface; database and storage stay internal.

checks.name: ships a compose file that publishes only the gateway on every interface
moves the shipped internal port mappings to 127.0.0.1 and leaves the gateway alone

controls.summary: Runtime database roles cannot run DDL; public probes cannot reach database or storage ports; backups restore.

checks.blocker: needs the disposable production-profile TLS deployment

controls.summary: Plain HTTP redirects to HTTPS at the edge and HSTS is sent there.

checks.blocker: needs the disposable production-profile TLS deployment

controls.summary: Session cookies carry Secure and __Host- over HTTPS, and a setting that disagrees with the URL is reported.

checks.name: reports Secure off on an https URL
issues the HTTPS session cookie with __Host-, Secure, HttpOnly, Strict, Path=/ and no Domain

controls.summary: Native passwords are Argon2id hashes with pinned parameters and a per-hash salt; older hashes are upgraded at sign-in, and an unknown account costs the same verification.

checks.name: writes Argon2id hashes with the pinned parameters and a fresh salt
spends a real verification on an unknown account
POST /auth/login rehashes a password stored with older parameters
POST /auth/login answers an unknown email exactly like a wrong password
POST /auth/login returns 401 for invalid credentials

controls.summary: Request bodies reject undeclared root and nested properties before any side effect.

checks.name: rejects undeclared root properties with 400 and constraint message
rejects undeclared nested properties with 400 and constraint message
POST /auth/login rejects an undocumented extra property with 400

controls.summary: Every raw HTML sink in the web app is reviewed and listed.
The web policy allows only its own origin and the identity provider, never inline script or eval.

checks.name: the page policy names no origin but its own and the identity provider
the build-time policy hashes scripts and never allows inline or eval

controls.summary: Malicious names and module text render inert on public, Control, TV and help pages under the enforced policy.

checks.blocker: needs the disposable production-profile TLS deployment

controls.summary: Repeated failed sign-ins and denied admin requests raise a redacted, deduplicated alert at a test receiver.

checks.blocker: no alert path to a test receiver exists yet

controls.summary: Every authenticated route declares its access requirement; an undeclared route fails closed.

checks.name: requires an explicit access requirement on every authenticated controller route
fails closed on an untagged route: treated as admin-control

controls.summary: An admin of one organization gets no access to another.

checks.name: does not grant organization B access from an admin assignment in organization A
does not reopen organization bootstrap after a historical soft-deleted assignment

controls.summary: Escalation and cross-organization attempts fail on the production profile with no data disclosed.

checks.blocker: needs the supported first super-admin command for the disposable production-profile deployment

controls.summary: Values are bound by Kysely; every raw SQL and dynamic identifier use is reviewed.
Placeholder secrets, unreadable proxy trust and mismatched cookie settings fail doctor without echoing values.

checks.name: reports missing values and default placeholder secrets without exposing their values
fails a setting the API would refuse at startup

controls.summary: Forwarded client addresses are believed only from named proxies, so limits cannot be dodged by a forged header.

checks.name: ignores a forwarded address sent by a public client
stops at the first untrusted hop of a forged chain
refuses %s, which trusts every address

controls.summary: Rate limits are shared across API replicas and stream connections are capped per address and node.

checks.name: shares one limit across independently initialized instances
admits up to the per-address cap, then refuses with a reason
caps the node before anything else

controls.summary: The API answers CORS only for COPALIBRE_APP_URL.

checks.name: rejects requests from unknown origins by returning only the permitted origin

controls.summary: Static, SSR, API, events and error responses carry the security headers behind the edge.

checks.blocker: needs the disposable production-profile TLS deployment

controls.summary: Framing is same-origin only and the API keeps its own policy.

checks.name: companion headers allow same-origin framing only
only the background-removal worker may evaluate code, and the API keeps its own policy

controls.summary: Session, CSRF and refresh cookies carry their attributes; logout clears all three; refresh rotates.

checks.name: native login sets the session, CSRF and refresh cookies with their attributes, and no token in the body
clears all three cookies with Max-Age=0 and the issuing attributes
drops a name that appears more than once, however many times

controls.summary: Cookie-authenticated unsafe requests need a CSRF header bound to the session; Bearer clients need none.

checks.name: refuses a matching pair minted for another session
refuses a value signed with another installation key
refuses a missing CSRF header with 403 and the standard envelope
needs no CSRF header from a Bearer client

controls.summary: Recovery and refresh tokens are hashed, expire, are bound to their purpose and are consumed once, even concurrently.

checks.name: refuses a consume that overlaps an uncommitted one
refuses a token of another kind without spending it
refuses an expired token
stores only a hash of the raw token
POST /auth/reset-password ends the refresh sessions opened before it

controls.summary: Photo and emblem uploads need authentication, are checked for dimensions and quarantined until scanned.

checks.name: refuses an unauthenticated upload attempt
404s once a photo fails validation, never serving a flagged object
refuses a person photo upload with the wrong width (a different aspect ratio)

controls.summary: Direct API uploads that are oversized, MIME-spoofed, path-traversing or decompression bombs fail on every upload route.

checks.blocker: import and module upload routes are not yet covered

controls.summary: No pricing or payment flow exists; the guard fails as soon as one appears.

checks.reason: CopaLibre has no pricing, checkout or payment flow
checks.inspected: apps/, packages/ and package.json, excluding tests and build output

controls.summary: No inspector, debug endpoint, stack trace or dev preview route is reachable on the production profile.

checks.blocker: needs the disposable production-profile TLS deployment

controls.summary: Invalid tokens and bad requests answer the standard envelope without internal detail.

checks.name: rejects an invalid token with 401 and no reason leaked
POST /auth/reset-password refuses a refresh credential and leaves it usable

controls.summary: Dependabot alert classification and the incident register are tested; the live audits run in the install job and before publication.
Candidate images for both architectures are scanned for OS and package vulnerabilities before publication.

checks.blocker: no pinned image scanner is wired yet

controls.summary: An unused-dependency analysis covering workspaces, dynamic imports and binary packaging has been reviewed.
Probes for .env, .git, backups, manifests and source maps, encoded or not, return nothing private.

checks.blocker: needs the disposable production-profile TLS deployment

controls.summary: Every available ref and its history is scanned for secrets, with redacted output.
Every confirmed compromised credential has revocation, replacement and verification evidence.
Workflows pin every action by SHA, publish only with locked tools, and upload CLI assets only from the tagged commit.

checks.name: a manual dispatch from another commit with the same version is refused
a successful upstream conclusion alone does not authorize publication

controls.summary: CLI, MCP, imports, workers, object access and egress have a recorded manual review.
The gate's own verdict, exception and redaction policy is tested.
